propositions: The code-review gate has five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach); only verify declares model: standard (172e); the remaining four steps inherit cfg.model implicitly, preventing per-pass model control on non-default providers
One env var (REBAR_LLM_MODEL or cfg.model) cannot express the required four-pass model mapping: Pass-1 finder on opus-family, Pass-2 verifier on sonnet-family, Pass-4 coach on sonnet-family
The code-review gate's step-level model declarations are silently ignored at runtime (plumbing defect b690); per-step model never reaches resolve_model during execution

Batch steps (round_a, round_b) require model_ladder inside the batch: sub-dict, not step-level model:, because interpreter.py:384-395 only reads from batch.get('model_ladder') and never passes enclosing step's model key

The verifier downgrade (standard class fallback for Pass-2/Pass-4) stops applying on any non-default provider because it conflates 'operator chose a model' with 'model equals default_model', breaking on Bedrock configurations
